sentences.en: She prefers contact lenses because she doesn't like wearing glasses.
sentences.zh: 她更喜欢戴隐形眼镜，不喜欢戴框架眼镜。

sentences.en: My son is growing out of his current contact lenses, so we need to get a new prescription.
sentences.zh: 我儿子的隐形眼镜要换大号了，所以我们需要重新配一下镜片。

sentences.en: The doctor recommended I try daily disposable contact lenses for convenience.
sentences.zh: 医生建议我试试抛弃式隐形眼镜，方便一些。
